defs.def: something that is wrapped in paper or put into a thick envelope so that it can be sent by mail, carried easily, or given as a present 包裹；小包

ex.s: VOLUNTEERING IN THE BUSH 8 March I just got a parcel from home!
ex.t: 丛林志愿服务 3月8日 我刚收到了家里寄来的包裹！

ex.s: Once the parcel hadbeenreceived bythisperson,he/shewould send the parcel onto a contact of theirs until the AStanleyMilgram parcel could be personally delivered to the correct person.
ex.t: 一旦包裹被这个人收到，他/她会把包裹寄给他们认识的联系人，直到包裹能被亲手送到正确的人手中。

ex.s: So, think about it for a minute: How might you be connected to the driver of the bus you regularly take or the person who delivers your parcels?
ex.t: 所以，花一分钟想想：你和你每天坐的公交车司机或给你送包裹的人可能有什么联系？

ex.s: Once the parcel had been received by this person, he / she would send the parcel ontoa contactoftheirsuntiltheparcel couldbepersonallydeliveredtothecorrect person.
ex.t: 一旦包裹被这个人收到，他/她会把包裹寄给他们认识的联系人，直到包裹能被亲手送到正确的人手中。

ex.s: That person in turn did the same until the parcel reached the person it was supposed to.
ex.t: 那个人也如法炮制，直到包裹到达应该接收的人手中。
